g.text: CampusClaw Session Event Direct POST Stream
[current model is invalid and a usable default exists]
reject before SSE and User Entry
persist User Entry and mark running
persist Assistant and atomically add lifetimeUsage
persist compaction and atomically add lifetimeUsage
Tool delta has no arguments and is never persisted.
Serialization, size, or backpressure failure drops only progress.
Compaction completion stores the full summary and retained boundary.
Failure never publishes a partial context and never deletes history.
Overflow compaction can retry the model call at most once.
